Our client is a fast-growing, Series A AI company (~50 people, European HQ) whose video-based AI agents monitor, optimize, and automate industrial production. Growth is standout: ARR up 5x in the past year and net revenue retention above 380%. As the first US commercial hire, you'll build the North American GTM from scratch, working directly with the CEO on six- and seven-figure deals into manufacturing and industrial accounts.

Build, own, and scale a pipeline across manufacturing and industrial verticals. Grow six-figure deals into seven-figure, multi-site AI programs through expansion. Navigate complex enterprise buying cycles with executive and operational stakeholders. Partner with the CEO and product/engineering to shape US GTM and roadmap. Travel up to 50% for on-site prospect and customer engagement.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 90 days: learn the product and industrial buyer, build a US pipeline, and advance early deals. First year: land and expand the first multi-site programs and establish the repeatable US motion.

3–7 years enterprise SaaS/software sales with consistent quota attainment; experience selling into industrial, manufacturing, IIoT, or automation environments; self-starter comfortable in early-stage, high-ownership settings; valid driver's license and willingness to travel up to 50%.

NICE-TO-HAVES

Experience as a first/founding sales hire; computer-vision or video-analytics background; multi-site enterprise expansion experience.

$120K–$150K base (USD), $240K–$300K OTE, competitive equity.

Remote with an East Coast base; up to 50% travel across the US.

HIRING PROCESS

### Our team will walk you through the full interview process when we connect.

This is a confidential search managed by our recruiting team on behalf of our client. We've kept the company name off the posting — apply and we'll share full details and introduce you directly. We're an equal-opportunity partner and welcome applicants of all backgrounds; compensation reflects the role's posted range.

## Story

Founding Account Executive в MSPilot, $2500–3500, Львів | DOU

MSPilotВсі вакансії компанії

MSPilot helps IT Providers deploy, govern, and monetize AI agents across their entire client base.

# Founding Account Executive

Львів $2500–3500

We’re a Y Combinator-backed startup building the AI infrastructure layer for the IT services industry: the platform IT providers use to deliver governed AI to the small businesses they manage.

It’s a genuine blue-ocean space — no incumbent has built this yet — while demand is already strong and validated. We’re getting around 10 inbound demo calls a day from IT business owners, booked from paid ads with no outbound and no sales team. The founder previously built an AI coding platform to 2M+ users.

Right now the founder takes every one of those calls. That’s the problem you’d solve.

This is a hybrid role based in Lviv — the founder is here and the team is being built here.

What you’ll do

You’d be the first sales hire, working directly with the founder, owning the calls and the close.

Run the demo calls. Take inbound demos with IT service provider owners and executives — often the CEO, frequently with their CTO or COO on the call. Discovery, product walkthrough, pricing, objections.

Close. Own the full cycle from first call through to a signed, paying customer: follow-ups, technical objections, security review, getting the right people in the room, and getting the contract done. Deals involve real scrutiny — these buyers are reselling to clients they’re liable for, so the security and compliance conversation is part of every sale.

Learn the buyer’s world properly. Our customers run their businesses on specific software — ConnectWise, Autotask, HaloPSA, NinjaOne, Datto — and they’ll know within two minutes whether you understand it. You’d need to learn that stack, and enough about how AI infrastructure actually works, to hold a credible technical conversation without deferring every question.

Build the relationships. This industry runs on trust and peer referral, not on outreach volume. Owners buy from people they’ve come to trust, often over months. The relationships you build are the asset.

Feed what you learn back. You’ll be closest to the market — hearing objections, requests, and reasons for no before anyone else. That shapes what we build and how we position it.

What we’re looking for

Who you are

- Based in Lviv, or open to being. Hybrid during the first months while you’re learning to sell this — apartment and travel covered if you’re relocating. Flexible after that.
- Genuinely interested in an unsexy vertical. Our buyers are IT service provider owners — small business owners with tight margins, real liability, and deep skepticism of vendors. You find people like this interesting rather than boring, and they can tell you respect them.
